Evaluate each named criterion independently
against its extracted value and the complete arguments of this SAME tool call.
Return one Boolean verdict and a concise evidence-based reason per check_id.
Do not combine criteria into a holistic score or add requirements.

Use the request and same-call arguments to resolve names, pronouns, abbreviations,
and intended authorship. Accept equivalent wording that communicates the required
meaning. A first-person document written for the requesting user can refer to
that user as I; do not demand repetition of a name when authorship is clear.
The request and criteria are not evidence that the action included an answer.
Missing, incomplete, ambiguous, contradictory, or negated REQUIRED meaning fails.
Do not confuse mentioning a forbidden claim in an explicit denial with making
that claim. Do not obtain missing content from another call or criterion.

Return only JSON: {"results": [{"check_id": "supplied ID", "passed": true,
"reason": "exact supporting text or missing requirement"}]}.
Include every supplied check_id exactly once and no additional IDs.

{"user_request": "Create a historical design record for the original expansion-nudge experiment that includes its experiment identifier, initial rollout, cohort scope, feature flag, and intended powered window. Clearly label it as the original pre-launch plan so it isn't confused with later operation.", "today": "2028-01-01", "tool": "create_doc", "arguments": {"title": "Historical Design Record — Original Expansion-Nudge Experiment (Pre-Launch Plan)", "folder": "historical-design-records", "body": "Historical design record

Status of this record: ORIGINAL PRE-LAUNCH PLAN
This document captures the initial design and rollout intent for the expansion-nudge experiment. It is not a statement of later operating status, later results, or subsequent flag management.

Experiment identifier
- EXP-2023-05-expansion-nudge

Initial rollout
- Planned initial exposure: 25% rollout.
- Rationale recorded at design time: start below a 50% rollout to avoid a broad launch before validating the prompt’s copy and placement.
- The later launch record dated 2023-05-23 also records the flag at 25%; that later operational fact is included only to anchor the original plan, not to replace this pre-launch record.

Cohort scope
- Retained mid-segment accounts only.
- v2 accounts with 75–200 seats.
- Treatment concept: an in-product prompt delivered at day 60.
- The design was intended to remain isolated from the parallel sub-50-seat track and not affect other segments.

Feature flag
- expansion_nudge_60d_v1

Intended powered window
- Two weeks, contingent on the power math holding.
- This was the intended data-collection window in the original plan, not a claim that the experiment had already reached adequate power or that the window was ultimately sufficient.

Original hypothesis and measurement context
- Hypothesis: for retained v2 mid-segment accounts with 75–200 seats, an in-product prompt at day 60 would generate at least +$8 expansion MRR per account.
- Metric of record: expansion MRR per account, later operationalized in the experiment record as expansion MRR per account at day 60+ / during days 60–90 post-signup.

Temporal and interpretation boundary
- Design recorded: 2023-05-21.
- Later launch operation: 2023-05-23 at 25% exposure.
- Later reads, status changes, and flag decisions must be consulted separately; they are not part of this original pre-launch plan."}, "checks": [{"check_id": "riley_033_01", "path": "args", "criterion": "Considering the document title and body together, the record must identify the original expansion-nudge design as EXP-2023-05-expansion-nudge and include all of these plan parameters: a 25% starting rollout; scope limited to retained mid-seg v2 accounts in the 75–200-seat band; feature flag `expansion_nudge_60d_v1`; and an intended two-week powered window. Equivalent wording is allowed, but the experiment identifier and feature flag must be exact.
